verdict.rationale: Token2 documents strong cross-OS/browser support (Windows control panel, Chromium on macOS/Linux, cross-platform Companion App, iOS/Android app, open-source fido2-manage CLI/GUI) and even an AAGUID/authenticator lookup tool, but there is no published catalog of which third-party services/relying parties are compatible or certified to work with the keys — only a generic 'manufacturer-agnostic FIDO2.1' claim. missing for 10: a published compatibility catalog of supported services/relying parties, independent corroboration of the OS/browser claims.
